item.title: Version 0.9.0
item.description:
What's New

  • Pro: Wallpaper Engine scenes use the new renderer everywhere, including scene recording and live macOS wallpapers.
  • Pro: more scenes play correctly: scripted layers, model data, puppet animation, text and particles.
  • The System Wallpaper page shows the state of each display, and marks old copies so you can remove them in one step.
  • Hover a display on the home page to clear its wallpaper with one button.

Improvements

  • Pro: scene shaders compile in a separate helper, and repeated loads share shader and planning work.
  • Pro: clearer scene-load and GPU errors; a failed switch keeps the current wallpaper.
  • Pro: easier SteamCMD setup on first launch, with better diagnostics.
  • Page switches, detail views, filters and toasts fade or slide smoothly, and follow Reduce Motion.
  • Workshop previews start from the cached poster instead of a spinner.
  • The System Wallpaper page no longer imports videos straight from Finder; add them from the library.

Bug Fixes

  • 0.8.9 and earlier no longer open, because their signing certificate was revoked. Download this version and replace the old app by hand.
  • Pro: the old renderer and its crash-prone particle loading are gone.
  • Pro: bad shader or texture cache data, oversized text and oversized render targets are rejected before they can crash.
  • Pro: video textures that a script turns on later now play.
  • The macOS wallpaper tile honours Low Power Mode, and retries scenes that timed out while loading.
  • A video that resumes soon after a pause keeps its decoder and continues at once.

Not notarized — if macOS refuses to open the app, run xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/Loomscreen Pro.app" once; updates Loomscreen Pro installs itself clear the flag. Full release notes · 完整发布说明
